title: Examination
paragraphs: “Whoa… that was fast. I guess it tickled?”
“There’s a lot more feathers than the average Filolial. The bone structure seems quite different too… Open your mouth.”
“P-Please stop it!”
Yuki-chan struggled and tried to lightly kick the attending physician, but the doctor seemed to anticipate her joint movements and narrowly dodged, forcibly grabbing her beak and prying it open.
“Ah…”
“Don’t struggle.”

Then, with smooth precision, the doctor inserted a syringe into her mouth and injected the medicine. W-What refined technique is this? Every time I witness this, I am amazed by the skill in restraining Filolials who resist examinations. Against familiar opponents, the doctor can subdue them without even using medication.

Even the Filolials I raised initially resisted and had to be subdued with medicine, but by the third time, they were held down with joint techniques alone. I even taught this to Assistant, and I remember how efficiently they handled it.
“Ah… Motoyasu-sama…”
Yuki-chan looked at me with pleading eyes. When I saw that gaze, there was only one course of action for me to take.
“I’m coming now!”
“Uh… um…”
Father stood frozen, observing the scene.
“You can’t move. I can’t conduct a proper diagnosis if you do.”
“Motoyasu-sama…”
I grabbed Yuki-chan’s wing to reassure her. I bet Rival probably thought I was going to kill the doctor. Unfortunately, I’m not that impulsive. More importantly, I can trust the doctor. However…
“If you paralyze my precious Filolials any further with medicine, I won’t forgive you!”
“Ah, yes, yes. Hmm… I see… So that’s how it is. I’ll just take a feather and some blood for genetic analysis…”
The doctor skillfully examined the immobilized Yuki-chan and conducted various tests.
“Yuki-chan, just a little more patience. You’ll be fine in no time.”
“U-Understood!”
It took about two minutes, I believe? The effects of the medicine wore off from Yuki-chan.
“Motoyasu-sama!”
Yuki-chan quickly stood up and hid behind me as her shield. She endured it well. I hugged Yuki-chan and gently stroked her head.
“Oh? The medicine wore off faster than expected. Well, whatever. The examination is over. She’s in excellent health.”
The doctor was already searching for Kou as the next target.
“Hm? Where is Kou?”
“He ran away. So did Sakura-chan.”
Father was watching the direction in which Kou and Sakura-chan had escaped.
“Father, you must not let them escape. This is the attending physician, and she will give a proper examination.”
“Uh…”
“I’m scared, na! I feel like she’s really reliable, but there’s this fear that I can’t move at all, na!”
“Amazing…”
Rival, in dragon form, was clinging to Father. With this, even Father couldn’t hold Sakura-chan back.
“What exactly is this ‘attending physician’? I’m an alchemist and a researcher, you know?”
“Um… it’s complicated, but… how should I put this? Motoyasu-kun is… kind of from the future.”
Father explained my situation to the attending physician. Whether she believed it or not, I could not say.
“So, what you’re saying is… in another possible world, I’ve already met the heroes?”
“That’s correct. Motoyasu-kun usually can’t perceive normal women as women, but since he recognizes Rat-san, that means she had a special relationship with him.”
“In the future, she served as the attending physician for Filo-tan and many other Filolials, I say.”
I also remember her managing the monsters in Father’s territory, as well as assisting me. I’m surprised to find her in a place like this.
“Hmm…”
The attending physician responded, seemingly uninterested.
“I get the story. Either way, you’re going to let me examine that dragon over there too, right?”
“Ah, yes. As long as you do a proper examination… preferably without using any medicine.”
“If they don’t struggle, I’ll take a look.”
“Uh… you’re not going to say something like, ‘I won’t know unless I take them apart,’ right?”
“What would be the point of killing them…?”

I remembered that Father had once mentioned that while the attending physician seemed a bit crazy, she was actually quite sensible. In other words, this place was the attending physician’s research lab. That means this is a trustworthy place.
“Okay, now stick out your tongue… Yes, yes, open your mouth wide.”
“Na—”

Rival opened its mouth wide and showed its tongue to the attending physician. After examining Rival’s mouth, the physician checked inside and then grabbed its stomach with her left hand while reaching deep into its throat with her right hand.
“Ugh… ugh…”
Father and Assistant were watching anxiously.
“Um, maybe don’t overdo it…”
“There’s a mixed attribute reaction in the breath sack and a strange response in the magic organ. I wonder if it’s because this is a monster raised by a hero?”

The attending physician muttered something while withdrawing her hand and checking Rival’s eyes, cheeks, and horns. Rival seemed to dislike being touched, but compared to having a hand shoved into its mouth, it preferred to endure by clinging to Father.
“Well, I guess that’s about it? There’s no particular problem. I’ve made some discoveries, but there’s no major illness.”
“Ah… I see.”
“Hmm… there’s a slight irregular flow of magic.”

The attending physician took a piece of paper nearby and began writing something like a medical record. Impressive. I’m starting to want to be able to perform health checks on Filolials anytime myself.
“Is there something wrong with Gaelion?” Assistant asked the attending physician anxiously.
The physician responded with a light smile to reassure them.
“It’s not that. For now, it’s just at the observation stage. Filolials are somewhat similar in that regard.”
“Na, na… Naofumi, I want you to pet me, na.”
“Ah, yes, yes. You did well holding on.”
Father gently stroked Rival.
“I endured, na! I’m better than Sakura who ran away, na!”
“Mmm…”

Oh? Sakura-chan and the others had returned and were making dissatisfied noises in front of the room door. But I have something to say. Sakura-chan and the others just have a higher sense of danger avoidance.
“Um, so, is there something strange going on with Gaelion-chan?”

“I’ve only skimmed through the research materials on dragons, but… speaking isn’t an issue. It’s been reported that purebred species called Dragon Emperors can speak, so that’s nothing to worry about.”
“Ah… okay.”
“Changes in the vocal cords are also within expectations. It’s the same with Filolials. Filolials can learn human language if you teach them, so there’s no need to worry about that.”
However, the attending physician scratched her head with a pen.
“Now, here’s the main issue. There’s a strange reaction around the magic core and the heart… it’s as if two living beings have been forcibly—”
“Gya, gyau—na, na!”
Rival let out a loud cry, cutting off the attending physician’s words. The attending physician looked annoyed at being interrupted.
“Sis, have Naofumi listen to the story. Gaelion and the others will go outside to watch the monsters, na.”
“Huh? But…”
Rival desperately whispered something into Father’s ear.
“Yeah, I’ll listen to it. Everything looks fine, so you can go. Imiya-chan, please go with them.”
“Ah, okay.”
Assistant and Mole, who had been quiet until now, left the room with Rival.
“Um, so…?”

“To continue… it looks as though two living beings have been forcibly fused while remaining conscious… but that’s not it. It seems like she’s far more compatible… as if she were designed to be like that from the start.”

What!? I already knew the attending physician was skilled, but she deduced all that just from a physical examination and checking the internal organs through the mouth without using any advanced equipment? I truly believe she is a genius.
“I thought it might be a parasitic monster, but it’s a little different. However, there’s definitely something inside that child. I’d recommend removing it.”
“Um… I don’t think that’s a problem, so please don’t worry about it.”
“Oh? Since this is a health check, I think it’s something worth discussing.”
“Well… since Motoyasu-kun seems to trust you, I’ll explain. Inside that Gaelion-chan is—”
Father explained that Rival was the Dragon Emperor and that, furthermore, Assistant’s guardian was inside Rival’s body. A kind of pseudo-dual personality.
